categories.main_business_segments: EverFocus Electronics primarily operates in industrial computers (IPC), vehicle-mounted industrial computers, and integrated image-based hardware and software solutions. Their business focuses on AIoT, smart transportation, smart manufacturing, and security surveillance systems. They also provide after-sales services and customized embedded system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages heterogeneous computing platforms integrating Intel, NVIDIA, NXP, TI, MediaTek, and Qualcomm processors. They develop AI edge computing platforms, AI image recognition software, and embedded systems with modular and flexible designs. Production involves PCB design, SMT assembly, firmware programming, and rigorous testing, adhering to automotive-grade standards like IATF 16949.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include ODM partners in the automotive industry, especially Japanese commercial vehicle brands, system integrators in Europe, and clients in smart city, smart healthcare, and industrial automation sectors. Major end markets are Taiwan, Asia-Pacific, Americas, and Europe, with strong presence in commercial vehicle markets and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: EverFocus operates globally with subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China (Shenzhen). Their sales and operations cover Taiwan, Asia (including China, Japan, Korea, Vietnam, India, Malaysia), Americas, Europe, and emerging markets such as Italy, Australia, and New Zealand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, and integration of industrial computers and AIoT solutions. They collaborate closely with upstream semiconductor and component suppliers and serve downstream system integrators and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transforming into an AIoT solution provider with a focus on vision AIoT, edge AI, and computer vision integration. R&D emphasizes multi-platform hardware development, AI image recognition, smart vehicle platforms, and embedded systems. The company also invests in sustainability, ESG compliance, and green manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial computers, vehicle-mounted systems, and integrated AIoT solutions. They also derive income from ODM partnerships, customized hardware and software solutions, and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EverFocus faces competition from established European, American, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese brands in the security and industrial computer markets. The company positions itself as a technology-driven AIoT solution provider with strong image processing and edge computing capabilities, holding over 70% market share in Taiwan's commercial vehicle segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$460 million, a 24.55% increase from the previous year, but still recorded a net loss of about NT$59.8 million. R&D expenses increased significantly, accounting for over 26% of revenue, reflecting aggressive investment in innovation. The company maintains a moderate asset base with ongoing efforts to improve profitability and expand market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EverFocus emphasizes high-quality, automotive-grade industrial computers with AI edge computing and integrated vision AIoT solutions. Their modular, flexible hardware platforms and proprietary AI image recognition software provide differentiated value in smart transportation, industrial automation, and security markets. Commitment to ESG and local brand value further strengthens their competitive edge.
